childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_intro_paragraph_1: Vana pavanoberekwa kuona kwavo kunenge kusina kusimba. Vanenge vakaita se 'mapofu'. Asi kuona kwavo kunozokura mumakore 5 kusvika 8 anotevera, uye kuvandudzika kukuru kunoitika mumwedzi 18 yekutanga yehupenyu. Iyi inguva yakakosha zvikuru.
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_intro_paragraph_2: Panguva iyi, hurongwa hwekuona hwemaziso nehuropi hunofanira kunge huri hwakanaka uye huchikurudzirwa. Iyi ndiyo nguva yakanakisisa yekuona chirwere nekutumira munhu kunorapwa.
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_identify_disease_titl: Nei uye sei tichiona chirwere kuti kuona kukure zvakanyanya
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_identify_disease_body: Chero chirwere cheziso kana chehuropi chinononotsa kukura uye chinoderedza kuona kwenguva refu. Ndokusaka zvakakosha kuona nekukurumidza sezvinobvira zvikonzero zvinorapika zvechirwere zvinokanganisa kuona kwakajairika uye kukura kwese.
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_question_bubble: Izvi zvinogona kuitwa nekubvunza nezvekuona, pamuviri, kuberekwa, chero zvirwere uye kukura kwese
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_observe_copy: Wobva waongorora maziso uchiyera kukura kwekuona, wobva waita kuongorora chirwere cheziso nekuita bvunzo ye fundal 'red' reflex uye nekuongorora chikamu chepamberi cheziso
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_1_paragr: Mudumbu, kacheche kanenge kasati kaberekwa kakakomberedzwa nokunzwika kunyoro uye kunodzikama, kusanganisira kurova kwemwoyo waamai vavo nemanzwi nemanzwi zvinobva kunyika iri kunze.
Sezvo pamuviri painosvika nhanho dzekupedzisira, maziso emwana anogona kuvhurika mukati mechibereko.
Nepo havasati vaona mifananidzo kana ruzivo, vanogona kuona shanduko muchiedza.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_1_image_: Mufananidzo wedanho repamuviri wemwana asati azvarwa ari mudumbu
Late pregnancy stage illustration inoratidza kuziva kwechiedza
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_2_paragr: Pakuzvara chiono chakasiyana zvikuru nechomunhu mukuru. Mwana achangozvarwa 'bofu' ane kusaona zvakanaka kweanosvika 6/600. Ivo havaone yakawanda ruvara uye vane yakaderera musiyano sensitivity. Havana stereovision uye maziso avo anogona kuputika nguva nenguva.

Ivo zvakadaro vanozotarisa zvakananga pazviso zviri pedyo zvakanyanya, uye kusvina maziso avo kuvharika kumwenje wakajeka. Chiono chavo kubva zvino chichakura nekukurumidza uye kuita semunhu mukuru pazera remakore masere.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_3_paragr: Mukati memavhiki maviri chiono chakavandudzika zvikuru. Ivo vanogona ikozvino kuona zvimwe, kunyanya kana zvinhu zviri pedyo. Iko hakuna ruvara uye izvo zvavanoona zvakati sandara, nekuti maziso avo haasati agara akatwasuka uye achishanda pamwechete kuti aone zvakadzama.
Dzimwe nguva maziso avo anotsvedza mukati kana kubuda kwenguva pfupi. Uku kunonzi kutswinya. Izvi zvinofanira kumira kuitika nemwedzi mitatu.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_4_paragr: Nemwedzi mumwe ruvara rwemavara runotanga kukura. Vachanyanya kufarira zvekuona kunyanya kune zviso. Vanozotangawo kuedza kutevera zvinhu zviri kufamba.
Ivo vanozowedzera kuziva manzwi akajairwa anosanganisira manzwi anozivikanwa semhuri yavo. Uye tanga kubatanidza izvo zvavanonzwa nezvavanoona.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_4_image_: Kukura kwekuona pakati pemavhiki maviri nemwedzi mumwe
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_5_paragr: Mumwedzi mitatu maziso avo anofanira kugara akatwasuka uye achishanda pamwechete kugadzira 3D kuona. Aya maonero matsva akadzama anovabatsira kusvika kune zvinhu nemazvo. Vachakwanisa kutevera zvinhu zviri kufamba nekukurumidza asi zvakaoma kushandura kugadzirisa kubva kune chimwe chiso kana chinhu kuenda kune chimwe nekukurumidza.
Vanoda kutarisa chinhu chimwe chete panguva. Vanogonawo kutanga kuita manzwi avo ekutanga ane revo.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_5_image_: Kukura kwekuona pakati pemwedzi mumwe kusvika mitatu
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_6_paragr: Mucheche ane chiono chinowanzoita chiono anozonakidzwa nekuona kapu yekunwira kana chipunu uye anogona kugara achigadzirisa nekutevera chiso ari chinhambwe chemamita 1-2 pamwe nekukwanisa kusiyanisa zviso zvakajairwa neasina kujaira nezviso zvavo zvese nemanzwi.
Vanogonawo kutanga kuona zvinhu zviri kure. Vachisundwa neshungu dzokuda kuziva, vanotanga kunanavira zvinhu.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_7_paragr: Pamakore matanhatu kusvika kumwedzi gumi nemiviri yezera kuona kwekuona kuri kuwedzera uye kwakapoteredza 6/36. Nhambwe inotariswa zviso nekuzivikanwa yakawedzera kusvika pamamita maviri. Zvese zvinhu zvekuona zviri kuvandudzwa nekunyatsosvika uye kubata.

Pazera rino ivo vari kuwedzera kufarira mifananidzo mumabhuku uye paterevhizheni, kunyangwe zvinhu chaizvo zviri kunyanya kuita zvichivakurudzira kukambaira uye kutenderedza zuva ravo rekuzvarwa, famba uchienda kune zvinhu zvinofarirwa. Kubhuya kwavo kuri kukura, uye manzwi anozova mazwi ekutanga pazera rino zvakare.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_8_paragr: Pakazosvika mwedzi gumi nemisere, kuona kunenge kwave munhu mukuru sekuti kuchiri kubvondoka pakunyatsoona kunosvika 6/18. Vachakwanisa kuziva zita ravo uye kushandisa mamwe mazwi.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_8_image_: Kukura kwekuona pakati pemwedzi gumi nemiviri negumi nemisere
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_9_paragr: Mushure memwedzi 18 yezera kuona kuchiri kuda makore akawanda kuti akure. Normal acuity yevakuru kuona ichaumbwa nezera re8.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_9_image_: Kukura kwekuona pakati pemwedzi gumi nemisere nemakore masere
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_10_parag: Mushure mezera re8 iyo yekuona system inogona kusanatsiridza zvakanaka kurapwa senge cataract kuvhiyiwa. Kuzivikanwa kwechirwere uye kuendeswa kunorapwa kunoitwa zviri nani pakutanga kwehupenyu sezvinobvira.

Zvinogona kuonekwa kuti kukura kukuru kunoitika pakati pekuzvarwa nemwedzi gumi nemisere yezera uye inoenderera zvishoma nezvishoma muhudiki hwose. Munguva iyi zvakakosha kuti mwana ave neutano hwakanaka nehurwere husina hurongwa hwekuona uye hupihwe nharaunda inokurudzira uye inovaka dzidzo.
Kukurumidza kuzivikanwa kwechirwere nekuendeswa kunorapwa kwakakosha kubatsira kukwidziridza zvese zvekuona uye kukura kwese.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_10_image: Mushure memakore masere mufananidzo wekukura kwekuona

assessmentVisionPage.cue_001: Vhidhiyo iyi inotsanangura nzira yekugadzirira mwana naamai kana muchengeti vasati vaita fundal red reflex bvunzo muvana vachangozvarwa uye vana vakura.

assessmentVisionPage.cue_009: Zvadaro, tarisa chiso nemaziso zvomwana. Zvibvunze mimwe mibvunzo.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_010: Mwana anoita seane kurwadziwa muziso rimwe chete here? Maziso akavhurika here kana kuti ari kuavhara zvakasimba?
assessmentVisionPage.cue_011: Pane kudiridza here kana kubuda mumaziso? Maziso acho akaenzana here? Maziso akazvimba here?
assessmentVisionPage.cue_012: Iye zvino, funga kuti mwana ari kuona sei. Fambisa chiso chako zvishoma nezvishoma kubva kune rumwe rutivi kuenda kune rumwe, uchiona maziso avo.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_013: Ita kunyemwerera wakanyarara. Mwana anotevera kufamba kwechiso chako here kana kuti anopindura kunyemwerera kwako kwakanyarara?
assessmentVisionPage.cue_014: Zvakare, zvibvunze mimwe mibvunzo. Maziso ose ari maviri anofamba zvakasununguka uye pamwe chete here?
assessmentVisionPage.cue_015: Maziso akatwasuka here kana kuti rimwe ziso rakatarira mukati kana kunze? Maziso anodonha here?

assessmentVisionPage.cue_019: Kazhinji, ziso rimwe chete harigoni kuona zvakanaka. Iwe kana amai vanokwanisa kuvhara ziso rimwe, ipapo rimwe.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_020: Fambisa chinangwa uye enzanisa maitiro emwana paanenge achishandisa maziso ose, uye imwe panguva.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_021: Kana mwana asingadi kuti ziso rimwe chete rakavharwa, zvinoreva kuti ziso rakashama harione zvakanaka.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_022: Kana iwe uchifunga kuti unogona kuona chimwe chinhu chisina kunaka neziso rekunze, tarisa zvakanyanya uchishandisa iyo loupe yekupedzisira yeArclight.

assessmentVisionPage.cue_024: Zvibvunze mimwe mibvunzo. Chikamu chichena cheziso chepingi here kana chitsvuku? Mboni yeziso kana cornea ipfumbu here kana chena?

usaidFundalReflexExamPage.cue_001: Vhidhiyo iyi inotsanangura mashandisirwo eArclight kuita fandal red reflex nekusarudza mwenje unopenya zvakanyanya.

usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_001: Vhidhiyo iyi inotsanangura zvakajairika uye zvisina kujairika fundal red reflex kutaridzika.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_002: Yakajairika fundal dzvuku reflex bvunzo ndipo pasina musiyano wakazara mukupenya uye ruvara pakati pemaziso maviri ane epakati cornea ratidziro.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_003: Kunyangwe chitarisiko chakajairika cheiyo fundal reflex, zvisinei, chinosiyana zvichienderana nekuti uri kure sei uye kuti mwana anotarisa kupi.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_004: Kuongorora kunoshanda uko kwaunofanirwa kufamba uchienda kudivi nekudzoka uye mberi mukati nekutenderedza ruoko kubva kumurwere.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_005: Vacheche nevana vachafambisawo maoko avo nemaziso, zvichiita kuti reflex ichinje maitiro ayo panguva yekuongorora.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_006: Mumwana mutema, reflex yacho inotaridzika kucheneruka, ine yero uye chena uye dzimwe nguva bhuruu seruvara rukuru.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_007: Zvakakosha, mukuongororwa kwakajairwa, hapafanirwe kuve nemusiyano wakazara mukupenya uye ruvara pakati pemaziso maviri ane epakati corneal reflections.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_008: An abnormal reflex kana paine kuramba kuchienderera, musiyano chaiwo mukupenya uye ruvara pakati pemaziso maviri.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_009: A displaced corneal reflection, chigamba chakasviba chiripo mukati me reflex yerimwe ziso kana maziso ose, kana kushaikwa zvachose tsvuku reflex.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_010: Abnormal reflex test inogona kuratidza kuvepo kwecataract, retinoblastoma, corneal scar, squint, refractive kukanganisa kana matambudziko ekuzvarwa akadai secoloboma.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_011: Izvi zvese zvinoda kumwe kuongororwa nenyanzvi.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_012: Tarisa pane iyi reflex uye zvibvunze iwe: izvi zvakajairika kana zvisina kujairika? Mhinduro dzinozotevera mushure.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_013: Iwe zvino unofanirwa kuve nekunzwisisa zvirinani kuti chimiro chenguva dzose chinoratidzika sei, pamwe chete nemafungiro asina kujairika, uye kukwanisa kupa chikonzero chingangonyanya kukonzera.
